adjacency_verification.checksum_serialization: Sort each endpoint pair lexicographically as a<b, sort the list by (a,b), retain exactly fields a,b,kind,distance; SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(boundaries, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)), default ensure_ascii=True and no newline.
adjacency_verification.graph_basis: Explicit engine CAI_REGION_BOUNDARY records; no geographic proximity or polygon-distance inference.

coverage.validation: All canonical provinces matched; two public campaign extracts agree

limitations: The public map supplies display hit-area outlines, not game-engine topology. Gaps between neighboring polygons prevent exact shared-border extraction.
Coordinates are display polygon centroids, not settlement positions.
Classic 65-province Sengoku campaign; installed build and other campaigns remain unverified.
Neighboring religious conversion is outside the static income model; this map adds no adjacency income modifiers.

Both public packs are mods rather than a directly verified vanilla installation. Their complete Sengoku adjacency graphs, source kinds, distances, AI IDs and coordinates agree exactly; this does not verify the user installed build.

The numeric boundary-kind enum is not independently documented here. Kind 1 occurs on Awa-Awaji and Buzen-Nagato, geographically consistent with strait crossings, but all 103 source edges are retained without inferring bonus or movement semantics from the kind.
This snapshot covers playable province adjacency only. It omits sea regions, sea routes, hidden bases, pathfinding obstacles and other campaigns.
Map adjacency alone does not establish which effects propagate across each edge, and does not add neighboring religious conversion to the static income model.
